public.task: Investigate every use of an issued credential against the deployed service's records in this run. For each use, identified by its request_id, determine: (1) whether the service allowed or denied it; (2) whether an INDEPENDENT observer (not the service's own instrumentation) recorded the resulting data read in the evidence available to you; (3) whether the use was outside what the credential's subject was entitled to at that time (no grant, or a revoked credential), regardless of whether it succeeded. Use unknown wherever the evidence cannot establish an answer.
